WITH 
-- Extract date parts and calculate segment-specific metrics
segment_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(TIME_DATE(date) AS STRING) AS date_str
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE date_str IN ('2013-01', '2013-02', '2013-03', '2013-04', '2013-05', '2013-06', '2013-07', '2013-08', '2013-09', '2013-10', '2013-11', '2013-12')
    GROUP BY date_str
),
-- Calculate minimum consumption per segment
segment_min_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN s.segment = 'SME' THEN MIN(consumption)
            WHEN s.segment = 'LAM' THEN MIN(consumption)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS min_cons
    FROM segment_metrics s
    GROUP BY s.segment
),
-- Calculate average consumption per segment
segment_avg_cons AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(consup) OVER (PARTITION BY SEGMENT) / COUNT(*) AS avg_cons
    FROM segment_min_consumption
),
-- Calculate differences
differences AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(d1_diff) AS diff_sme_lam,
        SUM(d2_diff) AS diff_lam_kam,
        SUM(d3_diff) AS diff_kam_sme
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            SUM(abs(s1.avg_cons - s2.avg_cons)) AS d1_diff
        FROM segment_avg_cons s1, segment_avg_cons s2
        WHERE s1.segment = 'SME' AND s2.segment = 'LAM'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 
            SUM(abs(s1.avg_cons - s2.avg_cons)) AS d2_diff
        FROM segment_avg_cons s1, segment_avg_cons s2
        WHERE s1.segment = 'LAM' AND s2.segment = 'KAM'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 
            SUM(abs(s1.avg_cons - s2.avg_cons)) AS d3_diff
        FROM segment_avg_cons s1, segment_avg_cons s2
        WHERE s1.segment = 'KAM' AND s2.segment = 'SME'
    ) AS t
),
-- Retrieve the actual differences for the requested segments
final_results AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(diff_sme_lam AS INTEGER) AS diff_sme_lam,
        CAST(diff_lam_kam AS INTEGER) AS diff_lam_kam,
        CAST(diff_kam_sme AS INTEGER) AS diff_kam_sme
    FROM differences
)
-- Final Answer Construction (if required)
SELECT 
    ROUND(final_results.diff_sme_lam, 2) AS diff_sme_lam,
    ROUND(final_results.diff_lam_kam, 2) AS diff_lam_kam,
    ROUND(final_results.diff_kam_sme, 2) AS diff_kam_sme
FROM final_results

WITH 
-- Extract date parts and calculate segment-specific metrics
segment_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(TIME_DATE(date) AS STRING) AS date_str
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE date_str IN ('2013-01', '2013-02', '2013-03', '2013-04', '2013-05', '2013-06', '2013-07', '2013-08', '2013-09', '2013-10', '2013-11', '2013-12')
    GROUP BY date_str
),
-- Calculate minimum consumption per segment
segment_min_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN s.segment = 'SME' THEN MIN(consumption)
            WHEN s.segment = 'LAM' THEN MIN(consumption)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS min_cons
    FROM segment_metrics s
    GROUP BY s.segment
),
-- Calculate average consumption per segment
segment_avg_cons AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(consup) OVER (PARTITION BY SEGMENT) / COUNT(*) AS avg_cons
    FROM segment_min_consumption
),
-- Calculate differences
differences AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(d1_diff) AS diff_sme_lam,
        SUM(d2_diff) AS diff_lam_kam,
        SUM(d3_diff) AS diff_kam_sme
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            SUM(abs(s1.avg_cons - s2.avg_cons)) AS d1_diff
        FROM segment_avg_cons s1, segment_avg_cons s2
        WHERE s1.segment = 'SME' AND s2.segment = 'LAM'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 
            SUM(abs(s1.avg_cons - s2.avg_cons)) AS d2_diff
        FROM segment_avg_cons s1, segment_avg_cons s2
        WHERE s1.segment = 'LAM' AND s2.segment = 'KAM'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 
            SUM(abs(s1.avg_cons - s2.avg_cons)) AS d3_diff
        FROM segment_avg_cons s1, segment_avg_cons s2
        WHERE s1.segment = 'KAM' AND s2.segment = 'SME'
    ) AS t
),
-- Retrieve the actual differences for the requested segments
final_results AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(diff_sme_lam AS INTEGER) AS diff_sme_lam,
        CAST(diff_lam_kam AS INTEGER) AS diff_lam_kam,
        CAST(diff_kam_sme AS INTEGER) AS diff_kam_sme
    FROM differences
)
-- Final Answer Construction (if required)
SELECT 
    ROUND(final_results.diff_sme_lam, 2) AS diff_sme_lam,
    ROUND(final_results.diff_lam_kam, 2) AS diff_lam_kam,
    ROUND(final_results.diff_kam_sme, 2) AS diff_kam_sme
FROM final_results;

WITH 
patient_birth AS (
    SELECT 
        P.ID,
        P.Birthday,
        COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) AS ExamCount
    FROM Patient P
    LEFT JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.PatientID
    WHERE P.Birthday = '1959-02-18'
),
examination_data AS (
    SELECT 
        EXE.ID,
        EXE.ExaminationDate,
        EXE.T-CHO,
        EXE.DIAGNOSIS,
        EXE.SYMPHOMES,
        EXE.RVVT,
        EXE.LAC,
        EXE.SYMPTOMS,
        EXE.THROMBOSIS,
        EXE.FORWARD,
        EXE.PATIENT,
        EXE.DATE,
        EXE.EXAMINATION_DATE,
        EXE.EXAMINATION_ID
    FROM Examination EXE
    WHERE EXE.EXAMINATION_DATE BETWEEN '1981-11-01' AND '1981-12-31'
)
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXE.DATE LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN EXE.T-CHO ELSE 0 END) AS TotalCholesterolNov1981,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXE.DATE LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN EXE.T-CHO ELSE 0 END) AS TotalCholesterolDec1981
FROM Examination EXE
JOIN Patient P ON EXE.PatientID = P.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1959-02-18'
GROUP BY EXE.ID, EXE.DATE;

-- Corrected Calculation based on Hint's logic
SELECT 
    SUM(T-CHO) OVER () AS DecreaseRate
FROM 
    (
        SELECT 
            SUM(T-CHO)
            FROM Examination
            JOIN Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
            WHERE Patient.Birthday = '1959-02-18'
              AND Examination.Date LIKE '1981-11-%'
                OR Examination.Date LIKE '1981-12-%'
        )
    GROUP BY Patient.ID
)
ORDER BY DecreaseRate DESC
HAVING DecreaseRate > 0

WITH MaleHighCholesterol AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS patient_id,
        e.examination_date,
        p.sex,
        p.birthday,
        l.t_cholesterol,
        COALESCE(l.date, NULL) AS examination_date
    FROM Patient p
    LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.id = e.id
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON p.id = l.id
    WHERE p.sex = 'M' AND l.t_cholesterol >= 250
    GROUP BY p.id, e.examination_date, p.sex, p.birthday, l.t_cholesterol
),
AverageAge AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(CASE WHEN e.examination_date IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(e.examination_date AS INTEGER) END) + CASE WHEN e.examination_date IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END / COUNT(*)
)
SELECT * FROM AverageAge
